newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil stocks seen mixed, gains-taking possible.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stocks seen mixed, gains-taking possible.

text.p: Brazilian shares are seen mixed Monday as the market's sharp rally in the last several weeks may prompt investors to take profits amid little fresh domestic news, brokers said.
But analysts noted the bolsa should keep rising if local equity funds continue pouring cash into the market.
"The bolsa may cool off today after surging for several weeks," a senior trader said.
"But we can't forget that equity funds may boost share prices," he added.

The funds have been the primary force behind the bolsa's recent bullrun. Only in June, Sao Paulo's Bovespa index, comprising the 47 most-active stocks, gained 10.7 percent, with the funds accounting for a large part of the trading.
Net inflows into stock funds amounted to about 3.4 billion reais last month, representing nearly 2.5 percent of the fund industry's total assets.
So far this month, the bolsa has risen 7.3 percent.
